tps.bug: Cleanup reference uses incorrect alias - should be 'idp-alias-' + i instead of 'alias'.
tps.evidenciaOpus: OrganizationCacheTest.java:381 and :424 register cleanup with testRealm().identityProviders().get("alias")::remove instead of the created "idp-alias-"+i / "idp-alias-20", so the 21 IDPs created by testCacheIDPForLogin are never removed and leak into later tests.
tps.evidenciaAstra: Bug: OrganizationCacheTest.java:381 and :425 register deletion of the literal alias "alias", rather than the created providers. TestCleanup.java:65–71 suppresses deletion exceptions, leaving the remaining providers behind; the claimed count is slightly overstated because OrganizationCacheTest.java:428 explicitly deletes one.

tps.bug: On a partial cache miss getForLogin merges the previously read login query into a newly revisioned entry, so a concurrent invalidation can be lost and stale IDP IDs for other organizations persist.
tps.evidenciaOpus: When the searchKey is missing, getForLogin (InfinispanIdentityProviderStorageProvider.java:233-240) invalidates the key, takes the current revision and builds a new query that copies the previously read query's entries; if another transaction invalidated the key between the read and this step, the stale entries are republished under the fresh revision.
tps.evidenciaAstra: Concurrency: InfinispanIdentityProviderStorageProvider.java:236–240 assigns a fresh revision while retaining the previously read query, and IdentityProviderListQuery.java:43 copies its old results without validation. CacheManager.java:165–172 checks the newly supplied revision and counter, allowing membership invalidated before that refresh to be republished.

tps.bug: Login-cache invalidation on update compares the organization-aware enabled state, so changing a broker to private while its organization is disabled skips invalidation and leaves the now-private IDP in the cached login list.
tps.evidenciaOpus: update() passes getById(...) (org-aware wrapper whose isEnabled includes org state, :455-466) as original to registerIDPLoginInvalidationOnUpdate (:403-411); with the org disabled, both predicates are false when BROKER_PUBLIC flips to false, so no invalidation, while the cache was filled from the raw delegate and still lists the IDP, which reappears once the org is re-enabled.
tps.evidenciaAstra: Bug: InfinispanIdentityProviderStorageProvider.java:91 obtains the original through getById(), whose wrapper makes isEnabled() depend on organization state at :438–441. Consequently, :405–406 can skip invalidation when a disabled organization's public broker becomes private, and OrganizationAwareIdentityProviderBean.java:80 only rechecks enabled status when that cached membership is reused.

tps.bug: The test never consumes or asserts getForLogin's returned providers and never repeats a query, so the cache-hit path that builds the result is untested and could return wrong IDPs without failing.
tps.evidenciaOpus: OrganizationCacheTest.java:399-412 discards the streams returned by getForLogin and asserts only IdentityProviderListQuery sizes, each mode queried once; the cache-hit path that builds the returned models (InfinispanIdentityProviderStorageProvider.java:243-254) is never executed or checked.
tps.evidenciaAstra: Test_gap: OrganizationCacheTest.java:401–414 discards every returned stream and checks only internal cache counts; subsequent query groups at :483–496 and :519–532 follow explicit invalidations. Since InfinispanIdentityProviderStorageProvider.java:230–231 populates the cache before returning results at :254, an empty returned stream or a broken cache-hit path can escape this test.

tps.bug: Adding the organization/BROKER_PUBLIC check to the shared LoginFilter.getLoginPredicate also changes IdentityProviderBean.federatedProviderPredicate, so with organizations disabled a user's linked IdP that has an organizationId but is not public is no longer shown on the login page.
tps.evidenciaOpus: IdentityProviderStorageProvider.java:254 adds `orgId == null || BROKER_PUBLIC` to the shared getLoginPredicate, and IdentityProviderBean.java:225-226 uses it unmodified as federatedProviderPredicate for the base bean used when organizations are disabled (getFederatedIdentityProviders:213). A user's linked IdP that carries an organizationId but is not public is now filtered out of the base login page, a behaviour change beyond caching.
tps.evidenciaAstra: server-spi/src/main/java/org/keycloak/models/IdentityProviderStorageProvider.java:254 adds an unconditional organization/public restriction, which services/src/main/java/org/keycloak/forms/login/freemarker/model/IdentityProviderBean.java:213 applies to linked providers through the predicate returned at line 226. With the organization feature disabled, model/infinispan/src/main/java/org/keycloak/models/cache/infinispan/idp/InfinispanIdentityProviderStorageProvider.java:433 returns the original provider without disabling it, so this new restriction removes previously visible, enabled linked IdPs.
